name: Sculpture
author: parrotify
description: A marble bust in the dark: the light flashes on the beats, the camera cuts to a new shot every few beats, the bust turns with the bass and changes direction. WebGL; the model needs Parrotify 0.0.9 or newer. Model: "Classical Healer Bust" by Sana Sato (Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0), simplified.
